body.name: \((m,Q,\Gamma,\kappa,\Lambda,\mu)\)
body.construction: For nonempty \(\mathfrak G\), let \(m_{\boldsymbol d,\mathcal T}(\vartheta)=(G_{r,\vartheta_r}(z_\ell))_{r,\ell}\), \(J_{\boldsymbol d,\mathcal T}=\partial m_{\boldsymbol d,\mathcal T}/\partial\vartheta^{\mathsf T}\), and \(Q_{\boldsymbol d,\mathcal T}(\vartheta;g)=\lVert m_{\boldsymbol d,\mathcal T}(\vartheta)-g\rVert_W^2\), where \(\lVert u\rVert_W^2=u^{\mathsf T}Wu\). If \(|\mathfrak G|\geq2\), set \(\Gamma_{\mathcal T}=\min_{\boldsymbol d\neq\boldsymbol d'}\inf_{\vartheta\in\Theta_{\boldsymbol d},\,\vartheta'\in\Theta_{\boldsymbol d'}}\lVert m_{\boldsymbol d,\mathcal T}(\vartheta)-m_{\boldsymbol d',\mathcal T}(\vartheta')\rVert_W^2\); if \(|\mathfrak G|=1\), set \(\Gamma_{\mathcal T}=+\infty\). Set \(\kappa_{\mathcal T}=\min_{\boldsymbol d\in\mathfrak G}\inf_{\vartheta\in\Theta_{\boldsymbol d}}\sigma_{\min}(J_{\boldsymbol d,\mathcal T}(\vartheta))\). For \(r_{\mathrm{id}}>0\), let \(\Lambda_{\mathcal T}(r_{\mathrm{id}})\) be the minimum squared \(W\)-distance between \(m_{\boldsymbol d,\mathcal T}(\vartheta)\) and \(m_{\boldsymbol d,\mathcal T}(\vartheta')\) over \(\boldsymbol d\in\mathfrak G\), \(\vartheta,\vartheta'\in\Theta_{\boldsymbol d}\), and \(\lVert\vartheta-\vartheta'\rVert_2\geq r_{\mathrm{id}}\), with value \(+\infty\) when this feasible pair set is empty. A valid chart-projection cover \(\mathscr C\) has nonempty rational boxes \(C_{\boldsymbol d c}\subseteq\Theta_{\boldsymbol d}\) and rational matrices \(P_{\boldsymbol d c}\in\mathbb Q^{d_{\boldsymbol d}\times KL}\), covers each \(\Theta_{\boldsymbol d}\), and jointly contains every pair \(\vartheta,\vartheta'\in\Theta_{\boldsymbol d}\) with \(\lVert\vartheta-\vartheta'\rVert_2<r_{\mathrm{id}}\) in at least one chart. Write \(\phi_{\boldsymbol d c}=P_{\boldsymbol d c}m_{\boldsymbol d,\mathcal T}:C_{\boldsymbol d c}\to\mathbb R^{d_{\boldsymbol d}}\) and define \(\mu_{\mathcal T}(r_{\mathrm{id}};\mathscr C)=\min_{\boldsymbol d,c}\inf_{\vartheta\neq\vartheta'\in C_{\boldsymbol d c}}\langle\phi_{\boldsymbol d c}(\vartheta)-\phi_{\boldsymbol d c}(\vartheta'),\vartheta-\vartheta'\rangle/\lVert\vartheta-\vartheta'\rVert_2^2\). On overlapping charts the same moment map is used, and equality of its values implies equality under every associated projection; hence one co-containing chart with positive margin separates each local pair.
